title: Early diagnosis for the onset of peri-implantitis based on artificial neural network.
summary: Full publisher text reports a specific peri-implantitis diagnostic model: random forest selects transcriptomic hub genes, then a five-hidden-layer ANN classifies 35 GEO samples; test-split AUC is reported as 1.0. This is narrow retrospective diagnostic evidence with substantial small-sample/overfitting risk, not clinical utility.
ai_technology: RF feature selection among transcriptomic DEGs followed by five-hidden-layer ANN diagnostic classifier.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: 13 hub genes and test-split AUC 1.0 reported on 35 total GEO samples (19 peri-implantitis, 16 controls).
evidence.unknown: Random split within a small retrospective dataset; authors note overfitting risk and need for larger validation; no clinical/imaging validation.
evidence.ai_role: RF feature selection among transcriptomic DEGs followed by five-hidden-layer ANN diagnostic classifier.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
